# The placement fixes of fix/float105 that a test game can show (1280x720, GUI scale 2 as the test world starts).
# The lock key's new messages need the key bound, which a test game can't do; ViewLockTest covers them.
# Run it on the branch, and with -f mod_ref=main to compare with the old code:
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/float105 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/float-fixes.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/float105 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/float-fixes.txt

# A clear night that stays night, nothing else in the sky
cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set sky OFF
set constellations false
set shootingStars false
set twinkle true

# 1. World layout, Direction North, Placement left on Floating from another layout (Placement is hidden in World).
#    Facing south, away from the words: fixed, no twinkling stars (they are up north with the words); old code, a
#    cluster of twinkling stars round the crosshair, following the view. Facing north both show them round the words.
set layout WORLD
set placement FLOATING
set direction NORTH
look 0 -22
sleep 10
shot float-stars-south
look 180 -22
sleep 6
shot float-stars-north

# 2. View lock on, Lines in the sky, facing west a little up; leave the world and come back. Fixed: the lyrics sit at
#    the crosshair again. Old code: if the game drew a frame before the server said which way you face, they are
#    pinned somewhere along the horizon between south and north (off screen here). Single player may not hit that
#    timing; a server is likelier to.
set layout LINES
set placement SKY
set direction FOLLOW
set twinkle false
set viewLock true
look 90 -20
sleep 6
shot float-lock-before
quit
sleep 5
join SkyTest
sleep 30
shot float-lock-after-join
look 180 0
sleep 4
shot float-lock-after-join-north
look -90 0
sleep 4
shot float-lock-after-join-east
set viewLock false
